title: AI asset in commercial game
author: baruhspinoza
selftext:
Does anyone know is this legal, on steam? 

Is there any game on steam with most of assets generated by AI?

comments.author: Bratchan
comments.body: There are alot of games on steam that are coming up with just AI stuff. YOu have to disclose that you use AI... they have a full page of information about it.

comments.author: ResenhaDoBar
comments.body: You'd have to disclose it, then doing so would kill your game commercially due to anti-AI freaks. So I wouldn't and fk it

replies.author: baruhspinoza
replies.body: Im not sure gamers care...maybe some but its mostly artists who are against.

replies.author: PhotojournalistBig53
replies.body: Yeah you have to disclose it on your steam page. But you can do it. And the anti AI league is hopefully not your customer base. Most people care about the quality of the game, not how it's made.

replies.author: ResenhaDoBar
replies.body: Brigading is the issue, look at my response above

replies.author: Impressive_Award_679
replies.body: nonsense. This anti-AI freaks are a loud crying minority. Most people dont care about the use of ai, aslong as the game is good and makes fun. So if you've made a great and fun game and tried to make it look "unique", than it definitly does not "kill your game commercially" xD

replies.author: ResenhaDoBar
replies.body: Yea but they will buy the game, negatively review and refund it, if you ever tried launching a game on steam you know how that can destroy the game’s chance of succcess

replies.author: Impressive_Award_679
replies.body: Sure i agree with you, that this is some kind of negativity with impact but just make sure u are not only relying on "new" steam costumers. Release first on different platforms, build up a community before. There are already 10000+ Games with AI usage "released" on steam without just having negativ reviews. And its not like people dont know this. If a game is atleast "mostly positiv" it doesnt impact the game as much as in the past anymore. Atleast in my experience. If your game is unique and good, it will be a success. Is it harder to make a atleast small success with a mediocre game? Yes. But this should never be the intention to release something on steam.

replies.author: SKNRSN
replies.body:
Nah, if someone leaves a negative review and refunds the game, it doesn't count for the overall review score on steam. There's shitload of games on steam that use AI assets and they have good reviews and a (relatively) big playerbase and nobody gives a shit outside of super small minority of high school kids on twitter. 

If your product is good, it will sell, but it has to be good, not a slop that uses the most basic image generation possible.

replies.author: Crushcha
replies.body: Can you name some? Not that I don't believe you but I'd like to check it out myself

replies.author: SKNRSN
replies.body:
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/3852250/Rocky\_Idle/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3852250/Rocky_Idle/) has fully AI generated assets and very positive reviews

There's a tag that you can use to show only the games that have AI disclosure on steamdb: [https://steamdb.info/tag/1368160/](https://steamdb.info/tag/1368160/)

replies.author: Crushcha
replies.body: Thanks! That reminds me of RuneScape, great example.....how many copies do u think they sold?

replies.author: SKNRSN
replies.body: Given that there's 200 reviews, I'd say at least 5000 copies, but probably a bit more. Tbh it's a really good game if you like this genre.

replies.author: Crushcha
replies.body: i hate how the guy worked on it for 2.5 years and some ppl left a negative review all b/c of AI usage

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body:
Sure but you have to disclose ai use

I am working on my second ai game on steam and steam hasn't bothered me

comments.author: Defiant_Bluejay_4549
comments.body: All Gamers care about the experience..  if it’s good they don’t care. there are the anti ai community who are artists and other developers who are the small loud minority.  But gamers are mostly judging the results..

comments.author: egod
comments.body: It's fine, you will just declare it during the steam pending verification. I am agree as well. Playing with AI arts or not doesn't matter to me.
